acceptance: Prove a supported generic input/workspace path with the deployed unchanged reviewer: realistic full fork delta affects its own sizing and source coverage while retaining the actual adoption PR identity; do not manufacture a passing receipt or assume an extension exists.

All SQLGlot pin formats, repository/tag rules, relocation/payload checks and lifecycle decisions remain in BenchBox; no Theseus source, policy-schema, release or consumer reviewer-pin change is part of this item.

Wrong Git mode/SHA/tag/ancestry, altered or unpinned archive, checksum/provenance/source mismatch, executable/binary hooks, alternate ZIP runtime bytes, encoding ambiguity and incomplete source coverage refuse adoption.

BenchBox-bound evidence includes exact PR base/head, both pins, fork/upstream commits, wheel hash and generic review result; a stale head/base or changed evidence invalidates it, and a pin-only oracle success cannot satisfy it.

Real historical fork/wheel replay exercises source verification and full-source review preparation, including reviewed rollback; runtime code never executes with write/reviewer credentials, and evidence is not shipped as unpacked runtime source.

Focused behavioral regressions, actual preparation/reviewer-boundary smoke, existing independent review and required CI pass on a merged BenchBox-only integration PR; any proven missing generic contract is explicitly unresolved, never called delivered.

description:
BenchBox must review the actual upstream/fork source delta behind a SQLGlot wheel adoption, rather than treating a tiny pin edit as a trivial dependency bump. Implement SQLGlot-specific canonical source/pin/artifact validation and prepared review evidence in BenchBox, reusing scripts/sqlglot_fork_diff.py and existing adopter/distribution helpers. Theseus remains unchanged and solely owns generic review sizing, bounded templates, execution and verdicts.

Decision gate before choosing integration: demonstrate that the deployed review application receives the complete consumer-prepared source evidence through a supported generic interface/workspace path, sizes the substantive source changes itself, enforces required source reads and binds its result to the real adoption PR base/head. Current inspection found generic file/diff/plan engine commands but has not established a supported external-source inlet. Do not assume one, mutate generated plan JSON, import private APIs, use a self-promotion adapter, force a model/template/size, or copy/fork the review engine. If the necessary generic contract is genuinely absent, report the precise gap and smallest separately scoped proposal; do not add SQLGlot awareness to Theseus or silently create a reviewer release prerequisite.

BenchBox prepares exact old/new Git pins and source trees, verifies immutable canonical fork/upstream identities and exact relocated wheel correspondence without executing candidate source with reviewer/write credentials, supplies complete required source evidence, and binds source/pin/wheel digests plus review receipt to the current real adoption head. Pin-only success and PR-body assertions do not prove source review. Missing/tampered/oversize evidence refuses adoption. Keep source evidence transient, outside shipped BenchBox packages; no checked-in or installed unpacked fork runtime. Preserve ordinary PR reviews and reviewed ancestor rollbacks. Land only the BenchBox consumer integration through existing independent review/CI; no Theseus source PR, package publication, or pin promotion.
drop_reason: Owner explicitly rejected core-owned upstream integration/source verification on 2026-11-05: benchbox-sqlglot must own integration and provide a trustworthy wheel; core only consumes it and tests unique core concerns. Drop this core full-source review/inlet task, not its producer-integrity intent. Source/build/runtime/wheel integrity is re-homed to sqlglot-e2e-fork-wheel-delivery; core identity binding remains in sqlglot-e2e-verified-wheel-adoption. Removed every live dependency. No Theseus plugin, release, generic external-source inlet or second review path.
